'''Elu''' is an Austronesian language spoken on the northern coast of [[Manus Island]], [[New Guinea]].<ref name=e25/> The usage of the language has been in decline in recent years.<ref>{{cite web |title=Elu Language (Papua New Guinea) |url=https://joshuaproject.net/people_groups/print/11745/PP |website=Joshua Project}}</ref>
